children: Shares of Electra Therapeutics are set to make their trading debut Friday after the clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company's upsized initial public offering was priced at the midpoint of expectations, raising $350 million.

The South San Francisco, Calif., company late Thursday said it is selling more than 23.3 million shares at $15 each, compared with prior plans to offer nearly 21.7 million shares at between $14 and $16 apiece.
Electra shares are due to begin trading later Friday on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the symbol ETRA.
